label: POC Onboarding: Install Content Library Item
mcp_tool_description: Install an item from CloudBolt's Content Library (content.cloudbolt.app) the way the library page does: onb_cl_collection is one of blueprints, server-actions, resource-actions, orchestration-actions, rules, recurring-jobs, ui-extension-packages, cb-applets; onb_cl_item the item's display name or id (leave it empty to list the collection). Used for the Jupyter Notebooks UI extension (4.2.1), the tmp cleanup recurring job (4.2.2), Resize VM (3.2.1) and the Ad-Hoc Script action (4.1.2). onb_cl_replace=true refreshes an item that already exists. Needs outbound HTTPS from the appliance (prerequisite P5). Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
